name: University of Windsor
description: The University of Windsor is a public comprehensive university in Windsor, Ontario, across the river from Detroit, with about 17,000 students.
whyIncluded: A fast-growing destination for international master's students in Canada: its international share rose from 10% to 22% of students by 2021, mostly at master's level, and it fixes tuition for each entering cohort.

livingCosts.summary: Windsor's own 2026-27 residence and meal-plan charges for an 8-month year; personal spending is set so the total meets Canada's study-permit cost-of-living floor (C$22,895). Transit is in the compulsory fees.
livingCosts.notes: UWindsor fee estimator, residence option: Laurier Hall single room CA$4,521 per term and 7-day meal plan CA$3,790 per term; 2 terms over 8 months. No personal-expense estimate published, so personal 0; the student transit pass is in compulsory fees. Fix 2026-10-15: Windsor publishes no personal/miscellaneous budget, so personal = CA$784.12 a month, the amount that lifts the 8-month total (housing + food = CA$16,622) to the IRCC study-permit cost-of-living requirement outside Quebec of CA$22,895 a year for a single applicant (applications up to 1 Sep 2026; CA$23,448 for applications after that date), read 2026-10-15 at https://www.canada.ca/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/services/study-canada/study-permit/get-documents/financial-support.html. Marked secondary because the personal line is the visa floor, not a university figure.

Programme runs 'Two Semesters (8 Months)', so annual = 2 terms, i.e. the whole programme, counted as durationYears 1; compulsory fees for 2 terms = per-term items (recreation 145.77, wellness 39.71, UWincard 11, GSS 27.71, international student society 3.50) x2 + sport & rec 2-term fees (75.97 + 18.40) x2 + GSS bus pass 316.48 + GSS drug plan 603.64 = 1,564.24. Round 7 (2026-10-13, Common Crawl captures of official pages): Base tuition CA$8,490.00 per term x 3 terms (same basis as the 2026 estimator row). Cohort rate locked by the International Tuition Guarantee. Compulsory ancillary fees for 2024-25 not computed (the schedule lists them per course/term; leave to fall back to current). The 2026 row uses the estimator's CA$13,117.50 x 2 terms for this 8-month programme, which equals the schedule's CA$8,745 x 3 = CA$26,235; the 2024/2025 figures use the schedule rate x 3 on that same basis (2024: CA$25,470 = CA$12,735 x 2). Base tuition CA$8,745.00 per term x 3 terms (same basis as the 2026 estimator row). Compulsory ancillary fees for 2025-26 not computed; leave to fall back to current. Fix 2026-10-15: durationYears changed from 0.67 to 1 so the calculator charges the whole 8-month programme's tuition (CA$26,235 = CA$13,117.50 x 2 terms) and compulsory fees (CA$1,564.24) once instead of two-thirds of them; the 2024 and 2025 history rows are likewise whole-programme (2-term) amounts and are unchanged.
